api_threats.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
api_threats.description: API endpoints don't verify if user has access to specific object
api_threats.mitigation: Implement authorization checks on every API call, use indirect references

api_threats.title: Broken Authentication
api_threats.mitigation: Use OAuth 2.0, JWT with proper validation, API keys with rotation

api_threats.title: Excessive Data Exposure
api_threats.description: API returns more data than necessary
api_threats.mitigation: Implement response filtering, use DTOs, principle of least privilege

api_threats.title: Lack of Rate Limiting
api_threats.description: No protection against brute force or DoS attacks
api_threats.mitigation: Implement rate limiting, throttling, API quotas

api_threats.title: Mass Assignment
api_threats.description: API allows updating fields that should be read-only
api_threats.mitigation: Whitelist allowed fields, use DTOs, validate input

api_threats.title: Security Misconfiguration
api_threats.description: Missing security headers, CORS misconfiguration, verbose errors
api_threats.mitigation: Configure security headers, restrict CORS, generic error messages

api_threats.title: Injection Flaws
api_threats.description: SQL, NoSQL, command injection through API parameters

api_threats.title: Improper Assets Management
api_threats.description: Old API versions still accessible, undocumented endpoints
api_threats.mitigation: API inventory, version deprecation policy, documentation

api_threats.title: Insufficient Logging & Monitoring
api_threats.description: API calls not logged, no alerting on suspicious activity
api_threats.mitigation: Log all API calls, SIEM integration, anomaly detection

api_threats.title: GraphQL Query Depth Attack
api_threats.mitigation: Query depth limiting, complexity analysis, query cost calculation

container_threats.title: Container Escape
container_threats.description: Attacker breaks out of container to access host system
container_threats.mitigation: Use security profiles (AppArmor/SELinux), drop capabilities, read-only root filesystem

container_threats.title: Malicious Container Images
container_threats.description: Using untrusted or backdoored container images
container_threats.mitigation: Use trusted registries, image signing, vulnerability scanning

container_threats.title: Secrets in Images
container_threats.description: Credentials or API keys baked into container images
container_threats.mitigation: Use secret management, scan images for secrets, .dockerignore

container_threats.title: Unrestricted Container Resources
container_threats.description: No CPU/memory limits allowing resource exhaustion
container_threats.mitigation: Set resource limits and requests, use resource quotas

container_threats.title: Exposed Docker Socket
container_threats.description: Docker socket mounted in container giving full host access
container_threats.mitigation: Never mount docker.sock, use Docker-in-Docker alternatives

container_threats.title: Insecure Container Registry
container_threats.description: Registry accessible without authentication or over HTTP
container_threats.mitigation: Use authentication, TLS, private registries, access controls
